description.zh:
保留查询字符串。取值范围：

- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to preserve the query string. Valid values:

- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

description.zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
description.en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0.

description.zh:
节点给客户端响应重定向地址时候使用的响应状态码。取值范围：

- 301
- 302
- 303
- 307
- 308
description.en:
The response status code used by the node when responding to the client with the redirect address. Valid values:

- 301
- 302
- 303
- 307
- 308.

description.zh:
重定向类型。取值范围：

- static：静态模式。
- dynamic：动态模式。
description.en:
The redirect type. Valid values:

- static: Static pattern.
- dynamic: Dynamic pattern.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-redirect-rule --site-id 1234560000 --site-version 0 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --type static --target-url http://www.exapmle.com/index.html --status-code 301 --reserve-query-string on --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreateRedirectRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --Type static --RuleEnable on --ReserveQueryString on --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --TargetUrl 'http://www.exapmle.com/index.html' --Sequence 1 --SiteVersion 0 --StatusCode 301 --RuleName rule_example
